item.name: Classic Obby
item.cardSummary: Classic Obby is an early obstacle course with a simple jump-and-clear objective.
item.objective: Jump across the obstacle course and reach the finish.

item.name: Minefield
item.cardSummary: Minefield asks players to cross safely by testing the route and avoiding failed tiles.
item.objective: Cross the minefield by testing tiles and finding a safe path.

item.name: Jungle Obby
item.cardSummary: Jungle Obby is another obstacle route built around jumping through the temple course.
item.objective: Clear the jungle-themed obstacle course and reach the finish.

item.name: Atlantis
item.cardSummary: Atlantis sends players through an underwater hoop route that must be cleared in order.
item.objective: Swim through all 31 hoops in order.

item.name: Fishing
item.cardSummary: Fishing is a repeatable activity where players cast for reward pulls instead of clearing a timed course.
item.objective: Cast for fish and item rewards as a repeatable activity.

item.name: Digsite
item.cardSummary: Digsite lets players dig through the ground to uncover chests and reward spots.
item.objective: Dig through the ground and uncover reward chests.

item.name: Pyramid Obby
item.cardSummary: Pyramid Obby is a desert obstacle course that fits the same short-run replay pattern as the early obbies.
item.objective: Clear the desert-themed obstacle course and reach the finish.

item.name: Ice Obby
item.cardSummary: Ice Obby is a cold-area obstacle course for another quick completion reward run.
item.objective: Clear the ice-themed obstacle course and reach the finish.

item.name: Sled Race
item.cardSummary: Sled Race is a downhill run where players steer past obstacles to reach the finish.
item.objective: Steer down the course, avoid obstacles, and reach the finish.

item.name: Chest Rush
item.cardSummary: Chest Rush has players break through five stronger chests before reaching the reward zone.
item.objective: Break five increasingly durable chests to reach the end reward zone.

item.name: Stairway to Heaven
item.cardSummary: Stairway to Heaven is a hidden climb under the map with a rare reward chance at the end.
item.objective: Climb the stairway for its extremely rare top reward chance.
item.hugeTitanicNote: Extremely low chance for Golden Huge Angel Dog

item.name: Flower Garden
item.cardSummary: Flower Garden uses planted seeds and grown pots to turn garden time into item rewards.
item.objective: Plant seeds in pots and collect their rewards after they grow.
item.rewards: Diamonds, coins, potions, and gift bags

item.name: Cart Ride into Preston
item.cardSummary: Cart Ride into Preston has players control cart speed with arrows while riding to the end.
item.objective: Control the cart speed and reach the end of the rail course.

item.name: Digsite
item.cardSummary: The Dungeon Digsite is a later digging room with the same chest-hunting loop in a different area.
item.objective: Dig through the dungeon ground and uncover reward chests.

item.name: Lucky Blocks
item.cardSummary: Lucky Blocks is a timed breakable room where players destroy blocks to spawn stronger black lucky blocks.
item.objective: Break Lucky Blocks during the 15-minute run or until six black blocks are cleared.

item.name: Advanced Fishing
item.cardSummary: Advanced Fishing adds Deep Pools to the fishing loop, giving later players extra reward targets.
item.objective: Fish for rewards and use Deep Pools for the advanced reward pool.
item.rewards: Fishing rewards and Deep Pool rewards
item.hugeTitanicNote: Chance for Huge Poseidon Dog and Huge Whale Shark

item.name: Hoverboard Obby
item.cardSummary: Hoverboard Obby uses a randomly generated obstacle course built around hoverboard movement.
item.objective: Ride through a randomly generated hoverboard obstacle course.

item.name: Diamond Wheel
item.cardSummary: Diamond Wheel is a diamond-spending spin activity instead of a timed course.
item.objective: Pay for a spin and collect the reward where the wheel stops.

item.name: Chest Raid
item.cardSummary: Chest Raid gives players 10 minutes to clear chest rooms and push deeper for rewards.
item.objective: Break chests and clear as many rooms as possible within 10 minutes.
item.hugeTitanicNote: Low chance for Huge Glitched Cat

item.name: Claw Machine
item.cardSummary: Claw Machine spends tokens to grab Arcade Eggs from the arcade machine.
item.objective: Spend a Claw Machine token and guide the claw toward a prize.

item.name: Treasure Hideout
item.cardSummary: Treasure Hideout is a 30-minute loot room where players break through reward drops before the entry closes.
item.objective: Break targets and collect drops during a 30-minute Hideout run.

item.name: Hacker Obby
item.cardSummary: Hacker Obby mixes obstacle movement with a Titanic Cat sightline that can send players back.
item.objective: Clear the laser course while moving only when the Titanic Cat is not watching.

item.name: Bank Heist
item.cardSummary: Bank Heist has players clear obstacles like laser barriers before reaching the reward zone.
item.objective: Disable barriers, clear obstacles, and reach the end reward zone.

item.name: Tiki Egg Hunt
item.cardSummary: Tiki Egg Hunt is a scheduled search for eggs with boosted Huge chances.
item.objective: Find boosted eggs hidden around the islands during the scheduled hunt.

item.name: Jungle Boss Fight
item.cardSummary: Jungle Boss Fight has players break high-HP boss chests while dodging attacks.
item.objective: Break high-health boss chests while avoiding their attacks.

item.name: Millionaire Race
item.cardSummary: Millionaire Race sends players through 20 rooms where prizes improve while the chance of getting nothing rises.
item.objective: Choose through 20 rooms where rewards improve but failure risk rises.
item.rewards: Room rewards that improve as risk rises
item.hugeTitanicNote: End reward includes Shiny Rainbow Huge Treasure Turtle

item.name: Tokyo Alley Minigame
item.cardSummary: Tokyo Alley Minigame sends players through alley chests while searching for the Tokyo Alley Egg.
item.objective: Break alley chests until the Tokyo Alley Egg is found.

item.name: Woodcutting
item.cardSummary: Woodcutting has players chop trees and finish quests to earn Wooden Gifts.
item.objective: Chop trees, complete woodcutting quests, and earn Wooden Gifts.
item.hugeTitanicNote: Wooden Gifts contain Huge Trojan Horse

item.name: Doodle Battle
item.cardSummary: Doodle Battle is a drawing contest against Doodle Dragon that resets drawing points after a win.
item.objective: Build drawing points, challenge the Doodle Dragon, and win a Doodle Gift.

item.name: Time Trials
item.cardSummary: Time Trials is a daily-limited breakable race where faster clears build points for three reward-chest tiers.
item.objective: Race through five breakable zones with ten waves each, then defeat the boss chest.
item.hugeTitanicNote: Chests can reward Huge Totem Cub, Huge Ancestor Eagle, and Titanic Scroll Dragon
